intro: Import many projects at once from a CSV or Excel file in the official template. Every row is reviewed before anything is written; the import is merged with the existing data through the “external ID” and never replaces it, and the whole batch can be rolled back.
offlineLong: You are offline. Downloading the template, uploading and reviewing a file need a connection; come back to this page when the network is back.
noAccessMessage: Importing is available to users who may enter projects.
templateHint: Fill one row per project under the template headers, unchanged. Required columns for new records: Arabic name, type, latitude, longitude and country.
limitMerge: A row with an existing “external ID” updates that project (only the filled cells); all others are created as new drafts.
limitNotImportable: Staff, salaries and restricted data are not imported from files; enter them in the project form.
uploadHint: The server reads the file and checks every row without changing any project; you review the result in the next step.
fileHint: Up to {size} and {count} rows. The first visible sheet of an Excel file is read.
file_too_large: The file is larger than {size}. Split it into several files.
action_update: Same project: update the existing one
mergeIntoNamed: The row is project {project}: update it with this row
commitSummary: {create} will be created, {update} updated and {skip} skipped.
invalidLeftOut: {count} rows with errors will not be imported. Fix them in the file and import them again.
commitDraftsNote: New projects are saved as drafts for review; an update writes only the cells filled in the file.
commitConfirmMessage: {create} projects will be created and {update} updated; {skip} rows are left out. You can roll back the whole batch later from the import history.
commitRefused: The server refused row {row}; nothing of the batch was written.
commitRefusedHint: Fix this row in the file or choose “Skip this row”, then run the import again.
doneHint: New projects are drafts waiting for review. You can roll back this batch from the import history.
historyEmpty: You have not imported any file yet.
rollbackConfirmMessage: The drafts created by “{file}” are removed and the fields it changed are restored, except those somebody edited after the import. Projects already submitted or approved are kept.
rollbackResult: {reverted} rolled back, {kept} left as they are, {conflicting} fields not restored because somebody edited them after the import.
rollbackNoAccess: You may no longer change {count} records; ask an administrator to roll them back if needed.
rollbackConflictsHint: Fields edited by others after the import were left alone so that their work is not lost.
code_area_ambiguous: The area name matches several areas; write its code.
code_out_of_scope: The location is outside your scope.
code_no_write_access: You may not change this record.
code_external_id_deleted: This external ID belongs to a deleted project.
code_duplicate_external_id_in_file: The same external ID appears twice in the file.
code_commit_failed: The server refused this row during the import.
code_possible_duplicate: A similar project exists; the row is skipped unless you choose “Create” or “Same project”.
code_duplicate_in_file: Looks like row {row} of the same file.
code_unknown_option: Not an official option; kept in the “other” text.
code_locality_new: New village; it will be proposed for a supervisor to approve.
code_name_ar_copied_from_latin: No Arabic name; the Latin name was copied.
code_point_outside_country: The point lies outside the country written; the point was used.
code_point_outside_area: The point lies outside the area written; the point was used.
code_donor_details_without_name: Donor amount or year without a donor name; not saved.
err_too_many_rows: The file has more than 5,000 rows. Split it into several files.
err_empty_file: The file has no data rows under the headers.
err_file_too_large: The file is larger than the limit (10 MB).
err_payload_too_large: The file is larger than the limit (10 MB).
err_unsupported_file_type: File type not supported. Use CSV or Excel (xlsx).
err_unsupported_media_type: File type not supported. Use CSV or Excel (xlsx).
err_invalid_multipart: The file could not be sent. Try again.
err_invalid_rows: The rows of the file could not be read.
err_rate_limited: Too many attempts in a short time. Wait a moment and try again.
err_forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
err_network: The server cannot be reached. Check the connection.
err_wrong_state: The batch's state does not allow this now. Refresh the page.
